biggest_catch: You must open the account in person at an ACNB Bank branch — there is no online application path — and the $25,000 average-balance tier means parking serious cash for 3+ months to get the $2,000.
catches: Account must be opened at a local ACNB Bank office — in-branch only, no online opening.
Use promo code Earn2000; offices apply the code when you open.
Within 60 days of opening: enroll in online banking with eDocuments, and get a Mastercard debit card with 10 unique transactions (posting can take 2+ days).
Bonus tier depends on average monthly balance for three consecutive months following the first statement cycle: $25,000+ = $2,000; $10,000-$24,999 = $1,000.
No stated promo end date — 'Offer is limited and subject to change or cancellation without notice.'

Not for existing Traditions Bank or ACNB Bank business checking customers or anyone who closed a business checking account in the last 12 months; trust/estate accounts, government entities, and municipalities are not eligible.
One gift per entity, up to 3 entities with common ownership; 1099-INT reporting applies.
Only available where ACNB Bank has offices (south-central PA and Maryland via NWSB division).

steps: Visit your local ACNB Bank office to open a Free Business Checking account and use promo code Earn2000.
Within 60 days of opening, enroll in online banking with eDocuments.
Get a Mastercard debit card and make 10 unique transactions within 60 days (allow 2+ days for transactions to post).
Maintain an average monthly balance of $25,000+ (for $2,000) or $10,000-$24,999 (for $1,000) for the three consecutive months following your first statement cycle.
After all requirements are met and verified, the cash gift is deposited directly into your new account.
timing: Cash gift deposited in the new account after all requirements have been met and verified.
